title: Expeditus
body:
# Expeditus

Expeditus is a bloat-free Fabric performance modpack base for vanilla Minecraft.

It is built for players who want better FPS, lower memory usage, faster loading, smoother chunk performance, and cleaner client/server optimization without changing the vanilla gameplay experience.

No extra content. No visual clutter. No gameplay bloat.

Just vanilla Minecraft, unburdened.

## Features

- Better FPS and rendering performance
- Lower memory usage
- Faster loading
- Smoother chunk and world performance
- Client and server optimization support
- Vanilla gameplay preserved

## Included focus

Expeditus uses a carefully selected set of lightweight Fabric optimization mods focused on rendering, memory usage, lighting, chunk loading, networking, and server performance.

Included optimization tools currently include:

- Sodium
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- Entity Culling
- More Culling
- Better Block Entities
- BadOptimizations
- ServerCore
- Krypton
- ScalableLux
- NoisiumForked
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- ModernFix
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API

## What Expeditus does not include

Expeditus does not add:

- Biomes
- Mobs
- Items
- Dimensions
- Maps
- Shaders
- Resource packs
- Visual overhauls
- Gameplay tweaks
- Inventory HUDs
- Minimap mods
- Zoom mods

The goal is to keep Minecraft feeling like Minecraft while improving performance.

## Recommended for

- Players who want a clean vanilla experience
- Servers that want a lightweight performance-focused base
- Modpack creators who want a simple optimization foundation
- Anyone who wants performance improvements without adding gameplay clutter

## Notes

Expeditus is designed to preserve vanilla gameplay. If a mod causes crashes, compatibility problems, or behavior that does not feel vanilla, please report it.

Inspired by the performance-first simplicity of Simply Optimized. Expeditus is not affiliated with Simply Optimized.
